scope: Owned core paths. Authored failure map, not exhaustive runtime discovery or proof all failures are tested.

components.purpose: Preserves local/LAN authentication and existing HUD protocol.
components.invariant: Auth, admission and MCP failures must preserve conversation and return bounded status.
components.costs: Adds request admission and gateway process; port rebind interrupts LAN sessions.
components.keep_condition: Keep while LAN owner access and HTTP compatibility are required.

components.purpose: Restricts model-callable surface to three fixed tools.
components.invariant: No direct model fallback on MCP failure.
components.costs: Child/WSL startup and isolation preflight latency.
components.keep_condition: Keep while restricted tool surface can be verified independently.

components.purpose: Separates chat/notes capabilities, budgets and generation scheduling.
components.invariant: Never release interrupted inference slot until serial runner availability is confirmed.
components.costs: Extra IPC, one-token recovery probes, conservative quota cooldown.
components.keep_condition: Keep if chat preemption and denied arbitrary templates remain necessary.

components.purpose: Denies raw inference TCP, host paths and external network access.
components.costs: OCI inspection and denial probes, platform-specific code.
components.keep_condition: Keep while offline privacy and model isolation are core requirements.

components.purpose: Keeps shared evidence grounded and document authors distinct from cited authors.
components.invariant: Unknown author/date stays unknown; index/provenance drift blocks grounded chat.
components.costs: Index hashing, bounded source retrieval and sidecar maintenance.
components.keep_condition: Keep if source accuracy and chronology improve verifiable answers.

components.purpose: Improves retrieval relevance using CPU semantic/rerank models.
components.invariant: Failure falls back to BM25; does not load models in chat process.
components.costs: Additional CPU/RAM/worker startup and rank deadlines.
components.keep_condition: Retain only if retrieval evaluation beats BM25 enough to justify measured latency/RAM.

components.purpose: Screens untrusted input and stages/holds sensitive generated output.
components.invariant: No release of held output; streaming checks complete prefix.
components.costs: Filtering false positives and quarantine ownership/retention work.
components.keep_condition: Keep while owner setup privacy is required; measure false positives and missed leaks.

components.purpose: Provides local CPU speech without cloud inference.
components.invariant: Text response can succeed with speech degraded; never cloud fallback.
components.costs: CPU/memory contention and platform IPC; shared model pins.
components.keep_condition: Retain voice features that improve measured interaction without starving chat.
failure_modes: speech held by output DLP (sentence skipped)

components.purpose: Builds resumable quoted study facts without modifying model weights.
components.invariant: Failed/truncated notes stay pending; interrupted attempts never save partial JSON.
components.costs: GPU hours, derived storage, fidelity/audit/retry work.
components.keep_condition: Retain if source-backed notes improve retrieval over original passages.

components.purpose: Keeps checkout edits separate from production with readiness and rollback.
components.invariant: No activation of rejected candidates; retain warnings and old release.
components.costs: Frozen snapshots, static scan time and retained images.
components.keep_condition: Keep while station availability and reproducible release checks are required.

components.purpose: Preserves chat through skill switching, compression and handoff.
components.invariant: Lossy summaries never grant permissions or replace full visible transcript.
components.costs: Prompt budget, summary inference and client state complexity.
components.keep_condition: Keep if long-session continuity works at acceptable bounded cost.

components.purpose: Makes structural growth and masked failures visible to owner.
components.invariant: Gate fails loudly; stderr diagnostics never contaminate model stdout protocol.
components.costs: Baseline review and owner log review; bounded diagnostic overhead.
components.keep_condition: Keep if it detects regressions and reduces incident diagnosis time.

external_boundary.model: Broker/model share network=none pod loopback; model pins and GPU ownership stay separate.
external_boundary.host: Windows/WSL/GPU/filesystem failures can terminate all components; Python diagnostics cannot survive a kernel crash.
